Looking for Martial Arts Near Barnstable or Yarmouth?

September 12, 2026 · Cristyan BJJ Academy, Hyannis MA

If you live in the Mid-Cape and have been searching for martial arts near you, you may be closer to a great academy than you think.

Easy to reach

Cristyan Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Academy is located at 1513 Iyannough Rd (Route 132) in Hyannis, easy to reach from Route 6 and convenient for students coming from Barnstable Village, Yarmouth Port, South Yarmouth, Centerville, Osterville, Marstons Mills, Dennis, and West Barnstable.

Programs for everyone

We offer Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Women's Self-Defense & Fitness, Box Fitness, Capoeira, and Teen & Adult Judo.

Why the drive is worth it

Structured curriculum, experienced coaches, and a family-friendly community make training something you'll look forward to.

Get started

Call (508) 364-7697 or stop by the academy to learn more about classes.

Train with us in Hyannis

Visit us at 1513 Iyannough Rd, Hyannis MA 02601 or call (508) 364-7697.

Get Started ➜
